target_pests: Stem Borer (Scirpophaga incertulas), Leaf Folder (Cnaphalocrocis medinalis) in Paddy; Diamondback Moth (Plutella xylostella) in Cabbage/Cauliflower; Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa armigera) in Tomato and Cotton.
recommended_dosage: 0.3 to 0.4 ml per Liter of water (60 ml/acre diluted in 150-200 L water).
safety_precautions: Wear nitrile gloves, eye goggles, and a face mask during preparation and application. Do not spray during peak bee foraging hours. Keep livestock away from treated area for 48 hours.
cibrc_status: Approved for registered label crops; strictly adhere to dosage rates.

target_pests: Sucking pests: Aphids, Jassids, Thrips, and Whiteflies in Cotton, Chilli, Tomato, Okra, and Paddy (Brown Plant Hopper).
recommended_dosage: 0.3 to 0.5 ml per Liter of water (50-75 ml/acre in 150-200 L water) or 0.1 ml/L for nursery drenching.
safety_precautions: Highly toxic to bees and aquatic organisms. Avoid spraying when flowering crops are in bloom. Wear chemical-resistant gloves and protective apron.
cibrc_status: Registered under CIBRC with restricted usage near apiaries.

target_pests: Paddy Blast (Leaf Blast, Neck Blast, Node Blast caused by Pyricularia oryzae).
recommended_dosage: 0.6 g per Liter of water (120 g/acre in 200 L water). Seed treatment @ 2.0 g/kg seed.
safety_precautions: Do not inhale dust particles. Use protective mask while measuring and mixing powder. Dispose of empty packets responsibly according to CIBRC guidelines.
cibrc_status: Registered for rice crop blast management.

target_pests: Early Blight, Late Blight, Anthracnose, Leaf Spots, Downy Mildew, Rust in Tomato, Potato, Chilli, Grapes, and Groundnut.
recommended_dosage: 2.0 to 2.5 g per Liter of water (400-500 g/acre in 200 L water).
safety_precautions: Contact protective fungicide; requires uniform foliage coverage. Wear protective footwear, eye protection, and full-length clothing. Wash skin thoroughly post-application.

target_pests: Whiteflies, Aphids, Mites, Thrips, Leaf Miners, early instar Caterpillars, and soft-bodied sucking insects across all vegetable, fruit, and field crops.
recommended_dosage: 3.0 to 5.0 ml per Liter of water + 1 ml/L organic soap/surfactant sticker.
safety_precautions: Eco-friendly, safe for beneficial insects, pollinators, and soil microbes. Spray during early morning or late evening hours to prevent photodegradation.
cibrc_status: Certified for Organic and IPM (Integrated Pest Management) programs.

target_pests: Spodoptera litura (Tobacco Caterpillar), Helicoverpa armigera (Pod/Fruit Borer), Diamondback moth in pulses, vegetables, and cotton.
recommended_dosage: 0.4 to 0.5 g per Liter of water (80-100 g/acre in 200 L water).
safety_precautions: Translaminar action requires good foliage wetness. Avoid direct skin contact. Store in cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
cibrc_status: Approved for borer complex across vegetables and pulses.

category: Broad Spectrum Inorganic Contact Fungicide & Bactericide
target_pests: Bacterial leaf blight, black arm in cotton, citrus canker, anthracnose, downy mildew, and damping off.
recommended_dosage: 2.5 to 3.0 g per Liter of water. For soil drenching: 3.0 g/L.
safety_precautions: Do not mix with strongly alkaline solutions or organophosphates. Wear protective eye gear. Wash spray equipment thoroughly after use.
